Class Tower

java.lang.Object
logic.tower.Tower
All Implemented Interfaces:
Upgradable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArcherTower, CannonTower, CrossbowTower, IceWizardTower, LightningWizardTower, PoisonWizardTower
public abstract class Tower extends Object implements Upgradable
Base tower type for all combat towers.

A tower tracks combat stats, placement state, upgrade state, and controls projectile spawning against in-range enemies.

      public Tower(int damage, double range, int fireCooldown, int cost, String spriteName)
      Constructs a tower with the given base stats and sprite.

      damage - base projectile damage
      range - attack range in world units
      fireCooldown - cooldown between attacks in ticks
      cost - placement cost
      spriteName - sprite resource path

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(List<Enemy> enemies, List<Projectile> activeProjectiles)
      Updates tower combat for one tick.

      When ready, the tower fires one projectile at the closest living enemy inside range.

      Parameters:
      enemies - currently active enemies
      activeProjectiles - projectile output collection
